brands.parent_corp: Absorbed into Goodman 1982 (Goodman retired the name ~1992)
oem_history: Surface Combustion 1927 -> Midland-Ross 1959 -> Laird ~1969 -> Smith Jones -> Goodman 1982
Post-1982 Janitrol-badged units are effectively Goodman and decode under Goodman YYMM
Pre-1982 units predate Goodman scheme — Goodman decoder yields unrealistic ages
brands.decoder_strategy: alias_to_goodman + pre_1982 flag: apply Goodman YYMM decoder; if decoded date <1982 OR implied age >40 yrs, suppress and route to plate-date.

split_ac.modern_pattern: Apply Goodman 10-digit YYMM decoder; suppress unrealistic pre-1982 results.
split_ac.nameplate_date_code_alternatives: Plate-date for pre-1982 units.
edge_cases: pre_1982=true suppresses unrealistic ages; most surviving units are post-1982 Goodman-era.

decoder_implementation_spec.input_signature: decode_serial(brand: str, serial: str, variant: str = 'split_ac') -> Optional[SerialDecodeResult]
fallback_chain: brand-default (split_ac) decoder if variant decoder absent

OEM-sibling decoder ONLY if confirmed equivalence (Bryant/Payne<-Carrier modern; American Standard<-Trane; Amana/Waller-Daikin<-Goodman; Ruud<-Rheem; Coleman/Luxaire<-York; Tempstar/Comfortmaker<-Heil ICP)
printed-plate date extraction (Gree/C&H/EcoStar YYYY.MM; Panasonic YYYYMM; Daikin Style1; Mitsubishi nameplate)
return None with reason (pioneer_not_decodable / pk_no_format / samsung_post_2018_unknown)

must_not_reuse.coleman: do NOT use Carrier decoder — use York/JCI (year=serial pos2&4, month=pos3 letter)
must_not_reuse.heil: do NOT use Carrier decoder — use ICP letter+YYWW (year=chars2-3, week=chars4-5)
must_not_reuse.mitsubishi_electric: do NOT use Lennox decoder — Japanese fiscal-year single-digit-year scheme
must_not_reuse.daikin_ductless: do NOT use Goodman YYMM — Japan multi-style; branch on prefix/length
